title: Read a named field
summary: Groovy: Read a named field. Read book.pages.
introduction: A map pairs keys with values. Dot syntax can read a simple text key.
learningObjectives: Read a named field with Groovy

blocks.text: Install a JDK and Groovy. Save each example as lesson.groovy and run groovy lesson.groovy.

blocks.title: Read a named field
blocks.code:
def book = [title: "Moon Trip", pages: 24]
println book.title

blocks.text: Dot syntax selects the title key from this map.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A missing map value may be null; plan for that.
